interpretation.training: Direct supervised 16-class baseline, exactly 400 v1 calibration labels; vocabulary, IDF and classifier fitted on calibration only.
interpretation.selection: One fixed recipe. Validation is diagnostic only; no hyperparameter, threshold or model selection.
interpretation.evaluation: Retrospective descriptive comparison on previously seen v1 test/stress. No new confirmatory holdout or zero-shot claim.
interpretation.stress: Stored 850-row stress is OOS-only. Historical mixed stress combines 450 banking test rows with those 850 OOS rows; overlaps main test.
interpretation.timing: CPU classifier-only batch timing, not HTTP/SLO goodput and not matched to prior L40S deployment measurements.
interpretation.scope: First 400-label TF-IDF baseline only. Full official 1600-label training and frozen embedding baselines remain pending. No language-model inference, GPU allocation, or old pipeline rerun.
